title: Iago, Richard Crookback, Edmund in King Lear, two bear the wicked uncles’ names
html_source:
Three great “villains” in Shakespeare’s works. Iago in Othello, Richard III, and Edmund in King Lear.

The latter two with the same names as Shakespeare’s brothers Richard and Edmund, whom Stephen will suggest seduced Shakespeare’s wife Anne Hathaway.
